rubrics.justification: Description is broadly consistent with a full blastocyst and acknowledges static-image limits, but it relies heavily on the provided 2AA grade and includes some speculative features (e.g., smooth zona, absence of degeneration) without clearly image-grounded detail.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve markers, endometrial thickness, semen parameters, BMI, lifestyle, and first-cycle status well, with appropriate emphasis on age-related aneuploidy as the main limiting factor.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, linking morphology and patient factors to prognosis; minor issues include some tension around the DOR label versus reassuring AMH/FSH and slightly broad probability framing.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based: single embryo transfer, luteal support per protocol, caution about morphology not predicting ploidy, and individualized discussion of PGT-A at age 37. Minor overreach includes limited specificity on fresh vs frozen decision-making.
Provides practical next steps for transfer, follow-up, and future planning, including SET, monitoring, embryo cohort review, and consideration of PGT-A; useful though not highly protocol-specific.
